title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 29-32 (Krodhasambhava, Anugrahaprada, Buddhi, Anagha)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 29 to 32: Krodhasambhava, Anugrahaprada, Buddhi, Anagha, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 29 to 32 with meaning
caption: Names 29 to 32 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 29 to 32**: **Krodhasambhava, Anugrahaprada, Buddhi, Anagha**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Krodhasambhava, Anugrahaprada, Buddhi, Anagha.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Krodhasambhava** means **Born of anger**. A rare name: commentators read it as her power that rises against adharma.
**Anugrahaprada** means **Giver of grace**. She gives without being forced: grace, not payment.
**Buddhi** means **Intellect**. Wise judgement protects wealth; Lakshmi is called Buddhi itself.
**Anagha** means **The Sinless One**. Pure and free from fault.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.

note: Written in our own words from the traditional list of names.
